objective: Register all native promises immediately, sum fulfillment values in input order and propagate the first observed rejection without awaiting unrelated inputs.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Promise.all is a current standard combinator.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Concurrent independent values often feed aggregate calculations.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Input order, fail-fast settlement and floating-point fold order generalize.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Finite values and bounded read-only arrays clarify the lesson.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Sequential awaiting can hide a rejection behind a never-settling input.

defects: First-observed rejection identity, initial membership capture and input-order Number addition were not explicit.
A sequential-await implementation passed all previous cases.
Work/space scope and the fact rejection does not cancel producers needed qualification.
rationale: Retain all correct Promise.all variants. Define read-only/frozen arrays of up to 1000 native promises, synchronous initial consumption, finite Number bounds and a +0 left fold without rounding. Rejection propagates the first observed reason even if another input never settles, without cancellation. Author linear registration/fold work and storage excluding waiting/producers. Add a bounded watchdog around rejection beside a never-settling input, a settlement-order-sensitive floating-point sum, post-call array truncation and a 1000-price total. The watchdog makes an incorrect unsettled result an observable false case rather than a whole-grader timeout.

objective: Wait for all native promise outcomes and return current Error messages for rejected entries in original input order, including empty duplicates.

defects: An absolute allSettled-never-rejects comment exceeded the ordinary-input contract, and stop-at-first wording could imply cancellation.
